description: This file defines the RouteResolverInterface, an interface for resolving routes within the Slim framework. It specifies methods for computing routing results based on a URI and method, and resolving a route by identifier.

methods.name: computeRoutingResults
methods.description: Calculates routing results for a given URI and HTTP method, returning an instance of RoutingResults.

methods.name: resolveRoute
methods.description: Resolves a route based on an identifier, returning a RouteInterface.
